notes.title: Intro to the Game: How Hero Power Works
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596151/869ed9781a3cc1cb3b3c548129cf1ba04c9a0ea9.png[/img]
Hero power is a special effect that triggers automatically every time you play a combo.
It grows stronger with each successful combination — up to a maximum of 5.

1. Combos = progress
Every time you combine two Basic cards into one Final, the hero power meter increases by 1 and activates instantly.
🔹 On the left: Hydra is played as a result of a combo — the power meter grows.

2. Final card — keeps the meter
When you play a Final card directly, the combo meter doesn’t increase, but it also doesn’t reset.
🔸 In the center: Archmage activates the current level of hero power — a smart move to maintain your combo chain.

3. Basic card alone — full reset
If you play a single Basic card without a combo, the entire hero power meter resets to zero.
🔻 On the right: Wind is played on its own — the full combo chain is lost.
📉 This is the least favorable move if you want to maintain your momentum.

💡 Tactics:
Hero power is your reward for consistent play. Keep building combos and avoid breaking the chain — every step counts.

🎯 Your power grows with each combo. Staying sharp is what keeps it.

notes.title: Intro to the Game: Hero Powers in Battle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596151/91178f827d664c1f21968c73fa7abd7dcd47c522.png[/img]

At the start of each battle, you choose one hero power to use until the fight is over. This choice shapes your tactics and the outcome of the match.

🔷 Healing Spell — restores your health. Ideal for endurance-based strategies and long fights.

🔶 Elemental Attack — deals damage to the opponent. Great for aggressive, fast-paced play.

🟢 Enchanter — buffs your played card, boosting its attack and defense.

🧪 There’s no one-size-fits-all — your hero power should match your deck, your approach, or the specific boss you're facing.

🎯 Try them all and find your perfect match!

notes.title: Intro to the Game: Chats & Intimate Rewards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596151/f7e4acdeacd6d7995c3ad4ff31509bb8668aa466.png[/img]

The game isn’t just about cards and battles — you can also chat with heroines: seductive, charming, and each with her own personality.

🖋️ Chats are a separate mode, where you build the conversation by choosing your tone and responses. Girls react to your style — sometimes teasing, sometimes bold.

🎁 The deeper and longer the chat goes, the more rewards you earn. Some girls send you photos along the way — and not just one.

📷 Your gallery of intimate photos grows with your progress in each dialogue. Some are easy to unlock, others require several rounds of flirting.

💬 Each heroine is different. Some are bold from the start, others demand patience and the right approach.

notes.title: Intro to the Game: Basic & Final Cards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596151/ff34812fe66e13fa1a604fece07594615a601c7a.png[/img]
[b]Basic Cards[/b]
Cards with starting stats that are used in the combination system. Two cards marked as Basic can be combined into one Final card — with stronger battle stats and a new visual.
Basic cards play an important role in discovering combinations and developing your deck.

⚔️ Moderate attack and defense stats

🔁 Used in combinations (2 Basic → 1 Final)

🧪 Suitable for discovering new combinations

🧩 Marked with the symbol B

[b]Final Cards[/b]
High-power cards that don’t participate in combinations, but can be key in battle.
Some Final cards are created by combining two Basics, while others can be obtained directly — from boosters, boss fights, or as rare rewards.

💥 Enhanced stats

🚫 Cannot be combined further

🎁 Obtained through combinations or by other means

🖼️ Feature unique — and often more revealing — artwork

🔷 Marked with the symbol F

Two cards marked as Basic (B) can be combined into a single Final card (F).
The combination only works if the pair is correct — not all cards are compatible. Finding the right match is part of the gameplay exploration.

🔹 Example:
Angel (B) + Death (B) → Fallen Angel (F)

Once successfully combined, you get a Final card with boosted stats and exclusive artwork.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596151/74ffbfe9ffe2eecef4dc182a657b669fe5f2101e.png[/img]

And that’s it — nothing complicated: just find the right pair and claim a powerful Final card.
